Python is one of the world’s most popular and widely used programming languages, and it’s a great first language for beginners. Python’s clear, readable syntax makes it easier to focus on fundamental programming concepts without getting overwhelmed by unnecessary complexity. It’s used across web development, automation, data science, artificial intelligence, and many other fields, so the skills you learn can take you in many different directions. In this course, you’ll start from the absolute basics. No previous coding experience is required.
